preconditions.description: The number of words N must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= length <= 1000 for length in lengths)
preconditions.description: Each word length must be a natural number not exceeding 1000.
The number of provided lengths must match the number of words N.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' if any(lengths.count(length) > 1 for length in set(lengths)) else True
postconditions.description: If any word length is repeated, output 'NO'.
If valid words can be constructed, output 'YES' followed by N lines of words.

postconditions.expression: all(len(word) == length for word, length in zip(words, lengths))
postconditions.description: Each output word must have the corresponding length specified in the input.
